summary: Validate historical miner economics and preserve USDB difficulty under fake PoW
details: Make fake PoW preparation apply the same USDB historical profile and difficulty policy as header verification; only sealing is skipped. Ordinary PoW and full consensus stubs retain their behavior.

Add independent three-node acceptance for first mint, same-owner and cross-owner inheritance, fixed-pass and address-bound collaboration, rejected forced gifts, and dormant transfers at the selected BTC height.

Reconstruct owner balances from Bitcoin transactions and independently check raw energy, inheritance, collaboration, aggregate balances, difficulty and per-block payouts, including test-only BTC and USDB activation boundaries and mixed gap policies.

Run the normal-rule lifecycle in Nightly and tagged activation acceptance in a separate Weekly shard with hashed test binaries. These local fake-PoW cases do not measure public-network latency or mining profitability.
